headline: Stocks are bouncing in futures after four straight S&P 500 declines as Nvidia's big beat meets a Fed priced for hikes, with PCE and GDP due Wednesday before Thanksgiving.
rates: Treasury yields are elevated with money markets pricing almost no cuts and rising odds of a Fed hike, though the 10-year slipped a couple of basis points Wednesday.
fed: October FOMC minutes (10-2 hold) came out Wednesday and Governor Barr spoke; no Fed speakers are listed for Nov 19-20.
oil: WTI was near $84 on Wednesday, down about 2% on a rising US crude stockpile and surplus worries, well below the recent Hormuz-driven highs.
geo: Iran tensions and tanker attacks near the Strait of Hormuz remain the oil wildcard, with only preliminary talk of US-Iran talks.

events.name: Q3 GDP (2nd est.) and Core PCE
